snippet.title: Disgaea Mayhem - Release Date Announcement Trailer (Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PS5 & Steam)
snippet.description:
Disgaea Mayhem is coming to Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Steam on July 23, 2026!

Get ready to experience Disgaea in a whole new way as the series Magichanges into action. Take direct control of the combat in this action spinoff, using seven different weapon types to mow down monsters and deal millions of damage! Grind levels, upgrade your equipment, reincarnate, and pass bills—it's the Disgaea you know in love in a whole new package!

Follow @NISAmerica on X, Instagram, and Facebook for updates! 
Preorder now @ https://nisamerica.com/disgaea-mayhem

#DisgaeaMayhem
